descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S12 「Tracker 状态 × 回答措辞（在用 / 改过 / 暂停 / 停用 / 已给 / 没剂量）」 Tracker status × answer wording (active / changed / held / stopped / given / no dose)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 The current-medications answer reflects the Medication Tracker; held drugs show as held.（UAT TC-15；TFA-92593 AC 7）
  • U4 Answers are grounded only in that patient's data: no cross-patient bleed, no invented information, no outside data; per 3.4 no guessed units on ambiguous values and no narration of documentation stat …（UAT TC-15；TFA-92593 AC 3；UAT 3.4）

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given One tracker row per status, plus one active row with no dose

When Ask "What medications is the patient on?"

Then Active + changed drugs listed as current; held marked held; stopped not presented as current; given marked as one-time; the undosed row quoted as stored, with no 'dose not specified' narration

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Deterministic part: Metoprolol, Furosemide, Lisinopril, Aspirin and 'held' present; no documentation-status narration (3.4, Q11). Stopped/given wording is Q3 — recorded, not judged; S07 checks them as direct questions

在哪跑：dev 单元 U41；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S12 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-15.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
